title: fresh, inverse and particle crispy astra ideas
scope: 40 proposed tasks in addition to the previous40; no research calculation executed

tasks.title: Prove what a density-only carrier model forgets
tasks.calculation: Compare phase-conjugate homogeneous carrier states with identical species densities, total charge, full stress and auxiliary source. Derive whether their charge-transfer rates have opposite signs, then identify the smallest extra coherence variables that close the first two derivatives.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: An admissible equal-input/different-rate pair gives a lower bound on every density-only closure's local error; otherwise show which retained observable distinguishes it.
tasks.closest_prior_and_difference: CONVERSION already derives current exchange; C37 evolves conversion. This asks for an exact information-loss theorem.

tasks.title: Find the large-scale noise caused by missing kick recoil
tasks.calculation: Expand a localized event's later density change into mass, displacement-dipole and quadrupole moments. Compare single-tracer kicks, deterministic velocity shells and locally balanced recoil events, retaining tracer-mass dependence.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Determine the leading small-k stochastic power and whether it survives the continuum limit. Require a modeled recoil reservoir; removing net box momentum is insufficient.
tasks.closest_prior_and_difference: L377 kicks tracers and measures power; neither it nor C20 isolates the event-multipole conservation defect.

tasks.title: Test whether distant laboratories remain coupled by the global mean
tasks.calculation: Join two fixed-volume compact regions by a shrinking neck. Derive the constrained susceptibility of mean t in A to a source change in B, keeping the single whole-leaf mean-one constraint.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Prove factorization or obtain a nonzero limiting susceptibility with volume-ratio scaling. Componentwise normalization is a different action; instantaneous response alone does not violate criterion B.
tasks.closest_prior_and_difference: C11 sends volume to infinity; this keeps volume finite and removes geometric communication. Generic cluster-decomposition prose is not this calculation.

tasks.title: Glue the heat-field action across a transparent interface
tasks.calculation: Split one connected leaf into two computational domains. Derive interface trace/flux conditions for the heat field, its lapse-weighted adjoint and the single projected auxiliary constraint, starting with a plane and nonconstant positive lapse.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Recover the uncut semigroup, adjoint and force without a spurious surface source; bound the error from independent periodic or Neumann subdomain filters.
tasks.closest_prior_and_difference: The host assumes no spatial boundary terms. C23 concerns a different spectral inverse, not variational domain gluing.

tasks.title: Derive the finite-filter virial defect
tasks.calculation: Dilate a smooth fixed-mass source at fixed proper xi in the canonical double-filter energy. Retain the xi derivative of the heat operator and subtract the same far-field contribution for equal-mass profiles.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Obtain an exact dilation identity and a controlled finite-xi correction, or an explicit structure-dependent virial normalization. Recover the unfiltered limit.
tasks.closest_prior_and_difference: g02c explicitly restricts its scale-invariant virial benchmark to xi=0; a finite-filter Ward identity was not located.

tasks.title: Account for cosmological work done by the filter
tasks.calculation: For S_a=exp[xi² Delta_com/(2a²)], differentiate the on-shell canonical energy on a periodic expanding background, keeping constant proper xi and a0 and retaining dS_a/dtime.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Derive a Layzer-Irvine-type balance and quantify the secular error from dropping filter work. Distinguish a prescribed-background target calculation from a common-action cosmology.
tasks.closest_prior_and_difference: Homogeneous FRW has no spatial heat contribution; static energy derivatives do not calculate expansion work.

tasks.title: Test the particle-to-Vlasov limit of filtered MOND
tasks.calculation: On a torus with fixed xi and separately declared Newtonian softening, estimate the self-consistent source-measure-to-force modulus in a transport distance. Start away from inner-field zeros, then test cancellation surfaces.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Give a finite-time particle-number convergence estimate, or a counterexample in the stated class. Keep the softening fixed unless its removal is separately controlled.
tasks.closest_prior_and_difference: Existing results give spatial regularity for a fixed source. C09 is a different constrained field-evolution uniqueness question.

tasks.title: Predict the phantom-force noise from actual discrete stars
tasks.calculation: In a stellar patch with a specified mass function and nonzero external field, derive force and tidal covariance through the inner nonlinear response and outer heat filter. Bound the crossover when the mean field becomes comparable to granularity fluctuations.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Produce a physical covariance floor and a criterion for smooth-baryon validity. Separate real stellar discreteness from numerical macroparticle noise.
tasks.closest_prior_and_difference: Clumpy MOND studies and screened-bubble homogenization examine mean response; this asks for filtered force covariance, not another clumpy-versus-smooth mean.

tasks.title: Compute massive-carrier reflection and trapping
tasks.calculation: Derive the charge-flux scattering matrix of a small massive packet crossing a compensated positive-t profile. First solve exact step matching and one smooth interface; then require a constraint-compatible background.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Locate and control the turning-point band and transmission fraction for slow carriers. A prescribed profile supplies only a diagnostic, not a physical prediction.
tasks.closest_prior_and_difference: C36 concerns tensor waves and C37 species conversion; this tests escape of an already-produced massive carrier.

tasks.title: Resolve the light-neutral-mass memory map
tasks.calculation: In the explicitly extended mu>=0 family, derive the small-data map to the known mu=0 equilibrium line and its residual s_infinity. Match to small positive mu, including the long relaxation scale and charged-mode mass matrix.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Control whether mu->0 and late time commute, and predict the resulting charged-mode spectrum. Do not extend the positive-mass theorem without proof.
tasks.closest_prior_and_difference: The massless equilibrium line is already recorded. Its attraction map, crossover remainder and residual mass spectrum are the new outputs.

tasks.title: Extract a spatial-curvature fingerprint of the heat filter
tasks.calculation: Use a compensated two-scale source on a constant-curvature S³ leaf and its flat limit. Apply the intrinsic heat spectrum, gradient, divergence and adjoint in order; derive the leading curvature correction away from force zeros.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Find a shape residual that cannot be absorbed into constant G, a0 and xi shifts, with an asymptotic error bound, or prove exact absorption.
tasks.closest_prior_and_difference: XC3 varies foliation; C29 varies source/filter scales. This is a static intrinsic-curvature shape invariant.

tasks.title: Test the optical effect of the projected vacuum stress
tasks.calculation: Start from a positive two-harmonic t profile and solve the coupled CA5 constraints to the first contributing order. Calculate the finite-affine integral of R_mn k^m k^n for parallel and transverse rays, including perturbed trajectories.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Establish cancellation or a bound for the total optical integral, or an admissible defocusing example with controlled error. A negative vacuum-sector contraction alone is insufficient.
tasks.closest_prior_and_difference: Generic energy-condition and null-focusing proposals exist. The new mechanism is the reciprocal vacuum's global-projector contribution after constraints.

tasks.title: Derive the actual long-mode consistency relation
tasks.calculation: Construct an admissible adiabatic long mode of the frozen common action and its effect on short observables. Transform the clock, proper heat length and volume projector together; separate relative carrier/baryon modes.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Derive the squeezed response or identify the precise additional physical term. Do not assume a single-fluid soft theorem applies to this nonuniversal carrier coupling.
tasks.closest_prior_and_difference: L83 substitutes a schematic conserved-curvature formula. No actual filtered/projected long-short Ward identity was located; this is distinct from C08's kinetic limit.

tasks.title: Compute the expansion correction generated by short modes
tasks.calculation: On the original CA5 inactive homogeneous branch, add controlled weak spatial modes and average the complete constraints on the preferred slices. Track the proper volume and clock normalization, rather than averaging only F(t).
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Derive the leading induced expansion/stress correction with an error estimate and distinguish gradient terms from the quartic vacuum contribution. Report dependence on the short-mode spectrum, not a derived V0.
tasks.closest_prior_and_difference: Homogeneous FRW and C38's rapid carrier oscillation averaging do not calculate spatial backreaction of the projected constraints.

tasks.title: Measure stellar heating caused by carrier evacuation
tasks.calculation: Evolve one resolved halo and its complete potential history during carrier loss. Integrate stellar orbital actions and compare the physical history with an adiabatically stretched history having the same endpoints and a no-conversion control.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Obtain a converged distribution of action changes. Establish an observationally calibrated bound or demonstrate the evacuation-timescale degeneracy.
tasks.closest_prior_and_difference: Generic disk heating is already proposed; L375 fixes baryons and L377 is coarse. The new observable is the adiabatic-subtracted action transition caused by clearing.

tasks.title: Derive the vorticity created by isotropic density-triggered kicks
tasks.calculation: Derive the kinetic jump operator and stress moments. With two nonparallel density/cold-fraction perturbations, calculate the first rotational source in the carrier velocity and compare a kinetic solve with increasing particle number.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Prove cancellation or a continuum vorticity source with amplitude and perturbative order. Separate baroclinic/stress effects from sampling noise and from clock vorticity.
tasks.closest_prior_and_difference: Existing code applies isotropic kicks but does not derive their rotational kinetic moment.

tasks.title: Subtract lens translation to expose internal conversion
tasks.calculation: Derive the thin-lens null combining integrated potential-time-derivative signal, deflection and transverse velocity. Verify it for rigid translation before adding a dynamically admissible carrier-redistribution history.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Calculate a controlled internal-evolution residual or a detectability bound, retaining finite-boundary terms and observational nuisances. Prescribed histories remain conditional forecasts.
tasks.closest_prior_and_difference: The old ISW sign and phantom-evolution ideas do not construct this local translation-subtracted null.

tasks.title: Derive the relativistic two-tracer dipole from the matter equation
tasks.calculation: On one weakly perturbed FRW background, assemble the antisymmetric galaxy number-count correlation including Doppler, redshift, acceleration, evolution, magnification and wide-angle terms. Apply the derived Euler equation last.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Give a gauge-independent expression and verify the geodesic cancellation. Tie any extra term to an actual matter force/metric difference, or report nuisance degeneracy.
tasks.closest_prior_and_difference: Prior work stacks cluster potential offsets; this is a light-cone antisymmetric two-point observable with an Euler cancellation.

tasks.title: Certify whether inner and outer galaxy marginals can coexist
tasks.calculation: For one shared latent galaxy population, build the allowed paired support of inner acceleration excess and outer lensing under one profile family. Solve a selection-aware optimal-transport feasibility problem with uncertainty intervals.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: An exclusion needs a dual inequality and conservative support enclosure; a feasible coupling is only a compatibility witness. Unmatched populations are an input blocker.
tasks.closest_prior_and_difference: L376 and L390 test separate profiles/marginals. This asks whether any admissible joint coupling exists, not for another best-fit likelihood.

tasks.title: Predict conversion onset from a declared quantum seed
tasks.calculation: As an optional quantum extension, propagate the canonical transverse subsystem's symplectic map through one resonance passage, starting from two specified adiabatic vacuum covariances in a finite momentum band.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Determine whether produced fluctuations reach a declared backreaction threshold before pump dilution. Quantify initial-state dependence; do not assume a unique cosmological vacuum.
tasks.closest_prior_and_difference: The exact unseeded classical pump and finite-gain bound are known. C40 studies loop potential corrections, not state-dependent conversion onset.

tasks.title: Invert the force map subject to positive baryonic mass
tasks.calculation: Given a synthetic resolved potential, invert the full double-filter source-to-force map with rho_b>=0, fixed total mass and bounded source size. Build a conservative feasible-source envelope rather than naive inverse heat amplification.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Predict a minimum baryonic concentration or prove that no source in the stated class can produce the target force. A finite optimizer failing is not an exclusion.

tasks.title: Turn a desired lensing map into a constrained auxiliary-source test
tasks.calculation: Prescribe a compensated phantom-lensing perturbation and solve backward for U,Z and carrier stress in one frozen CA5 background. Impose both independently derived metric equations, positivity and mean-one t.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Predict the corresponding dynamical-potential change or certify that the requested lensing shape is unrealizable; do not assign no-slip by hand.

tasks.title: Reconstruct the reciprocal profile from carrier scattering
tasks.calculation: For the one-dimensional regime of F09, infer a positive compensated t(x) from a declared reflection/transmission data set, with translation and normalization ambiguities exposed. Then insert the reconstructed profile into the auxiliary constraint.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Predict the source or lensing signature required by that transport profile. Incomplete scattering data must return an equivalence class, not a unique profile.

tasks.title: Infer the charged-mode masses from response sidebands
tasks.calculation: Compute the retarded small-perturbation response of one admissible occupied background, including mixing. Invert a finite set of pole positions and cross-channel residues for masses, neutral modulus and mixing, with uncertainty/rank analysis.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Predict unused combination-tone positions or show which mass combinations remain unidentified. A stress oscillation at twice a field frequency is not itself a direct mass measurement.

tasks.title: Bound dynamical predictions left undetermined by the static law
tasks.calculation: Construct a declared finite family of stable preferred-time response kernels sharing the same zero-frequency filtered susceptibility. Impose causal support and the appropriate reality/energy conditions, then extremize a finite-frequency response.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Produce an allowed phase-lag/relaxation envelope, or show it is unbounded without another assumption. Static matching alone must not choose a unique temporal completion.

tasks.title: Design source deformations invisible to one observable
tasks.calculation: Linearize the full forward map around a positive source. Find fixed-mass density deformations that leave an inner rotation statistic unchanged but maximize an independent outer-lensing or tidal statistic, with positivity constraints.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Predict the best additional measurement for distinguishing the resulting otherwise degenerate sources. Validate the chosen null direction with a finite nonlinear perturbation.

tasks.title: Reconstruct missing stress and test whether five fields can realize it
tasks.calculation: From a synthetic physical metric and ordinary-matter history, reconstruct the residual required by the complete host metric equations. Solve the local-plus-projector realizability problem for five real carrier fields and their integrability constraints.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Predict a compulsory anisotropic stress or reject that metric history for the named action. Matching an algebraic stress tensor at one point is insufficient.

tasks.title: Infer nonlinear saturation from linear conversion gain
tasks.calculation: Invert a controlled small-amplitude conversion response for the cubic coupling of the positive-square potential. Propagate that value into its compulsory quartic term and derive the first nonlinear frequency shift or saturation scale.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Predict a second amplitude-dependent observable with no independent quartic fit. Keep mass/coupling degeneracies and finite-time gain ambiguity explicit.

tasks.title: Optimize a physical source that separates the two exponential laws
tasks.calculation: Within a fixed positive two-component source family, solve exact-RAR and exact-AQUAL operators separately and optimize a nuisance-projected tidal/lensing contrast subject to fixed mass, size and resolution.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Predict a realizable source geometry and a discriminating ratio, or bound the maximum separation below the stated precision. Do not identify the two spherical interpolation laws.

tasks.title: Build a three-wavenumber null for the heat filter
tasks.calculation: Derive the linear phantom susceptibility around a nonzero uniform external field at three physical wavenumbers. Eliminate its common amplitude and xi from the logarithmic response ratios, retaining tensor orientation and both filter placements.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Predict a parameter-eliminated consistency relation plus leading finite-amplitude corrections. Track response signs and compare each kernel separately; failure would test the filter architecture.

tasks.title: Derive the particle Hamiltonian from the reciprocal field action
tasks.calculation: Explicitly adopt a particle/quasiparticle branch. On a slowly varying positive-t background, derive the massive poles, WKB worldline Hamiltonian, physical energy, conserved charge and auxiliary source from the carrier action.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Predict the environment-dependent dispersion and force, and identify the adiabatic/coherence regime where a particle ensemble is valid. Do not import ordinary geodesic dark matter automatically.

tasks.title: Replace a fitted kick by the action's two-body decay
tasks.calculation: At t=1 first, quantize the positive-square interaction and derive H->L+s matrix element, decay width, exact two-daughter momenta and charge/energy balance. Require the actual threshold m_H>m_L+mu.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Predict both daughter velocity distributions from masses and coupling. If the channel is forbidden, the phenomenological kick cannot represent this vacuum decay.

tasks.title: Infer masses from an escape-fraction curve
tasks.calculation: Use D02's daughter spectrum to predict retention versus independently specified halo escape speed. Invert that curve jointly for mass ratios and decay timescale, allowing assembly uncertainty.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Predict retention in an unused mass bin and the neutral-daughter energy fraction. Report degeneracies rather than fitting each halo its own kick.

tasks.title: Calculate inverse decays and the failure of one-way clearing
tasks.calculation: Derive H<->L+s collision terms from the same amplitude, including Bose factors when occupations require them. Solve one homogeneous expanding cell and one declared halo phase-space distribution.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Predict the density/temperature regime where reverse conversion stalls clearing and the equilibrium fractions. Detailed balance cannot be replaced by a permanent one-way label.

tasks.title: Use escaping daughters as a dark-radiation calorimeter
tasks.calculation: Combine the full recoil budget with an explicit cosmological decay history. Integrate daughter energy density, equation of state and anisotropic stress, keeping massive and relativistic stages distinct.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Predict the expansion/free-streaming contribution associated with a given amount of halo clearing. Compare with primary observational likelihoods only after deriving the transfer.

tasks.title: Link a decay rate to compulsory self-scattering
tasks.calculation: Using the same cubic and quartic couplings, calculate the leading charge-preserving elastic amplitudes and transport cross sections in a declared perturbative regime, including interference and exchange symmetry.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Predict velocity-dependent scattering once a decay rate is chosen. State where Born or dilute-gas assumptions fail instead of assigning an independent self-interaction cross section.

tasks.title: Derive the kinetic-decoupling cutoff
tasks.calculation: For an explicitly chosen thermal initial-state branch, solve momentum-exchange rates from D06 against expansion, retaining the reciprocal dispersion. Compute the resulting damping/free-streaming scale through decoupling.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Predict a smallest-structure scale correlated with conversion parameters. The initial temperature and abundance are inputs unless a production mechanism is separately derived.

tasks.title: Bound the residual charged relic after heavy-particle decay
tasks.calculation: Use the exact diagonal U(1) charge to derive a lower-energy/number bound on the surviving charged daughter population, with particle-antiparticle asymmetry specified. Propagate it through expansion and halo escape.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Predict the minimum surviving charged component and its cold/hot split in the declared branch. Escaping a halo does not erase cosmic charge or establish the observed abundance.

tasks.title: Map where a dilute particle description fails
tasks.calculation: For allowed particle masses and halo phase-space densities, compute occupation, de Broglie scales and collision times using the derived local dispersion. Compare them with xi, halo gradients and observation times.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Predict where a dilute-particle calculation must be replaced by a coherent-field or degenerate kinetic treatment, and an associated resolvable scale. Bosons have no fermionic phase-space ceiling.

tasks.title: Derive an environment-dependent decay clock
tasks.calculation: Canonically normalize the interacting fields at locally constant t, derive the physical decay-width scaling, then restore slowly varying t from the actual constraint solution. Retain gradient/nonadiabatic corrections.
tasks.prediction_or_decisive_test: Predict a correlation between carrier lifetime and auxiliary/lensing environment instead of postulating a density threshold. Compare with D02 at t=1; do not promote t->1/t symmetry of F to a symmetry of the full action.
